Raw hex address 0x1c38bc0 assigned to bare local `pCVar4`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `pCVar4` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.

Watcom shadow-pointer walk — `pCVar8` self-updates via pointer arithmetic on an inner array field reached through a chained field path; the array decays to a pointer and `+ CONST` adds `CONST * sizeof(element)` bytes, matching the outer array stride. Replace `pCVar8->some_field[0]` reads with direct indexing on the original pointer; drop the shadow init and self-update.
